### LiteLLM metrics not wired
LiteLLM's built-in Prometheus `/metrics` endpoint is an **Enterprise** feature (moved out of beta into Enterprise on 2024-09-15, ~\$250/mo). On this OSS build `GET /metrics` returns **404** even with the master key, so there is no scrape target.

**Options to populate this row later:**
- Run the free community DB-exporter [`ncecere/exporter-litellm`](https://github.com/ncecere/exporter-litellm) (reads the LiteLLM Postgres DB → spend, tokens, latency, per-model usage).
- Request a free 3-month Enterprise license from BerriAI (beta-migration policy).

vLLM (the actual inference backend behind the `deepseek→local` fallback) is fully instrumented below.
